newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa, Karstadt see talks progress.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa, Karstadt see talks progress.

text.p: Negotiations between German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG and German retailer Karstadt AG about cooperation in the tourism sector have been successful to date, Lufthansa said on Thursday.
"The next step is to introduce the matter to the supervisory boards of the respective groups," a Lufthansa spokesman told Reuters.

The German newspaper Sueddeutsche Zeitung reported on Thursday a decision on combining Karstadt unit NUR Touristik and Lufthansa tourist flight-operator Condor into one unit would be reached at supervisory board meetings in September.

Lufthansa CEO Juergen Weber said at Lufthansa's annual shareholder meeting in late June that Condor and NUR were engaged in intensive discussions at management levels about possible cooperation in the tourism sector.
Both companies have avoided making statements on the issue.
At the beginning of July, the Handelsblatt newspaper said the two companies planned to set up a joint venture called Touristik AG.
